notes: A195673.A195673_conjecture: for all p q : Z and n, rowPoly (p+1) (q+1) n - rowPoly p q n = Polynomial.Chebyshev.S Z n, where rowPoly p q n = sum_k C (T p q n k) X^(n-k) and T is the entry's recurrence with T(0,0)=p, T(1,0)=q, T(1,1)=0. Route: T_lin (T is linear in (p,q)), rowPoly_rec (p(n) = x p(n-1) - p(n-2)), rowPoly_one_one. A195673_coeff gives it coefficientwise; A195673_data checks the 71 data terms by decide. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none (A053119's S(n,x) identified with Mathlib Chebyshev.S by the recurrence stated in A053119).

sources.what: identity stated as a conjecture, no proof

prior_art.note: Immediate from linearity of the recurrence in the initial values.
